name: What are the benefits of adding an in-law suite to my home?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of adding an in-law suite to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding an in-law suite provides multiple benefits, including accommodating multi-generational living, offering privacy for family members, and potentially increasing property value. It can also serve as a flexible space for guests, a home office, or even a rental unit (subject to local zoning). For families with aging parents, it allows for close caregiving while maintaining independence for all residents, making it a practical and valuable home addition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include multi-generational living, privacy for family members, increased property value, and flexible space use.
